text.body: || śrīḥ śrīmadānandātīrthabhagavatpādapraṇītasarvamūlagranthāḥ praṇavakalpaḥ|| śrīmaddhanumadbhimamadhvāntargatarāmakṛṣaaṇavedavyāsātmakaśrīlakṣmīhayagrīvāya namaḥ || samiccarvājyakānhutvā samyakpuruṣasūktataḥ | sarveṣāmabhayaṃ datvā viraktaḥ pravrajeddharim || 1 || śrutvā bhāgavataṃ śuddhamācāryaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajet | adhīhi bhagavo brahmetyasmai brūyādguraḥ param || 2 || uccārayaṃstristāraṃ dakṣiṇe śravaṇe tathā | ṛṣicchandodailatāni brūyāttasya kramātsudhīḥ || 3 || antaryāmīti gāyatrī paramātmetyanukramāt | viśvaśca taijasaḥ prājñasturyaścākṣaradevatāḥ || 4 || kṛṣṇo rāmo nṛsiṃhaśca varāho viṣṇareva ca | parañjyotiḥ paraṃbrahma vāsudeva iti kramāt || 5 || akārādestathā śānatātiśāntāntasya devatāḥ | evamuktvā tu taddhyānaṃ brūyācchiṣyāya sadguruḥ || 6 || aṣṭapatre tu hṛtpadmamadhye sūryenduvahnigam | pīṭhaṃ tanmadhyapagadmasthaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayam || 7 || udyadādityasaṅkāśaṃ tejasā'nupamaṃ sadā | sahasreṇāpi sūryāṇāṃ sañjñānānāndarūpiṇam || 8 || atiraktatalaṃ bhāsvannakharājivirājitam | vṛttajaṅghaṃ vṛttajānuṃ hastihastorumūśvaram || 9 || mahākaṭitaṭābaddhakāñjīpītāmbarojjvalam | nimnanābhiṃ sutrivalaṃ suvṛttodarabandhanam || 10 || viśālavakṣasaṃ bhrājatkaustubhāmuktakandharam | vanamālādharaṃ hāravaijayaṃtyādibhiryutam || 11 || pṛthudīrghacaturbāhuṃ śaṅkhacakragādāmbujaiḥ | yuktamunnidrapadmākṣaṃ sphuranmakarakuṇḍalam || 12 || pūrṇacandrāyutodrikāntimanmukhapaṅkajam | subhruvaṃ sulalāṭāntaṃ kirīṭābaddhamūrdhajam || 13 || niḥśeṣaduḥkhaśamanaṃ nityānandaśucismitam | viśvādīṃścaiva kṛṣṇādīnevaṃbhūtānsanātanān || 14 || abhinnāneva satataṃ tasmādviṣṇoḥ parātmanaḥ | varābhayodyatakarānnityānandaikarūpiṇaḥ || 15 || evamaktvā gururdhyānaṃ śapathaṃ kārayettataḥ | na viṣṇu vaiṣṇavāṃścaivāpyutsṛjeyamiti triśaḥ || 16 || na cānyadevatāsāmyaṃ tadaikyamathavā hareḥ | cintayeyaṃ mṛto vā'pi na cāpyekatvavādibhiḥ || 17 || samatvavādibhirvā'haṃ saṅgaccheyaṃ kathañcana | tannindakaiśca tadbaktanindakairvā mahāmune || 18 || evaṃ kṛte tu śapathe mastake hastapaṅkajam | nidhāyottīrya saṃsārātsukhī bhavaḥ hareḥ priyaḥ || 19 || sarvaduḥkhādibhirmukto nityānandaikarūpiṇaḥ | samprāpya viṣṇusāmīpyaṃ tatrāpi haribhaktimān || 20 || baktimāṃścānyadeveṣu tāratamyaṃ ca sarvadā | sarvotkarṣaṃ smaranviṣṇorbūyāścaiva sadā sukhī || 21 || na muktau viṣṇunaikyaṃ vā muktānāṃ sāmyameva vā | smarethā iti coktvā tu samayānanuśikṣayet || 22 || nityaśaśca hareḥ pūjā japadhyānasamarpaṇam | kartavyaṃ tu tvayā vatsa japaśca trisahasrakaḥ || 23 || madhyamaḥ praṇavasyokto yo'varaḥ sa sahasrakaḥ | trisahasrātparo yastu sa uttamajapaḥ smṛtaḥ || 24 || ātmānaṃ pratibimbatve dhyāyanbimbaṃ janārdanam | dhyāyaṃśca satataṃ vatsa saparyā nityaśaḥ kuru || 25 || mānasairvātha puṣpairvā praṇavena samāhitaḥ | anyāṃśca vaiṣṇavānmantrāñjapethā bhaktipūrvakam || 26 || śṛṇuṣva vaiṣṇavaṃ śāstraṃ sadā vedārthatatparaḥ | vedānmantrānupaniṣatsahitānvasarvadā śṛṇu || 27 || itihāsapurāṇe ca pañcarātraṃ tathaiva ca | tadarthānbrahmasūtraiśca samyaṅnirṇīya tattvataḥ | viṣṇoḥ sarvottamattvaṃ tu sarvadā pratipādaya || 28 || || iti śrīmadānandatīrthabhagavatpādācāryaviracitaḥ praṇavakalpaḥ samāptaḥ || || iti praṇavakalpaḥ || || śrīkṛṣṇārpaṇamastu ||
